sources.finding: Choose reminders by observed response, compare like cohorts, and penalize recent repetitions. Historical technical case study, not proof of a current exact algorithm.
Separating the minimal streak action from the daily goal improved retention in their reported experiment. Avoid making a habit dependent on a demanding perfect score.
Behavioural learner styles, varied achievements and language-specific creative work make reports more personal and shareable.
Returning users need a distinct re-onboarding experience, not only a reminder to return.
Use live behaviour to segment, orchestrate channels, personalize content and timing, and evaluate controlled experiments.
Measure the intended subsequent action, not only message opens.

interpretation: Eligibility thresholds, contact limits, rewards and experiments in this program are proposed Flags product decisions. They are not claimed to be Duolingo settings or proven results for Flags.

codeAudit.currentReward: First eligible daily game: +1 F-Buck, or +2 if perfect. Subsequent eligible perfect games: +1. Timed play, duels and mistake-review are excluded from this reward rule.
codeAudit.currencyStorage: UserProfile.addFBucks records a local balance/history. A campaign offer needs an authoritative server reward receipt and idempotent app application before reward emails can go live.
codeAudit.missingData: The existing aggregate progress endpoint has no session timestamps, local play hours, per-country answer windows, marketing consent, or campaign conversion events. These cannot be inferred retrospectively from total games and XP.
